summary: All nine states pass standard pose/motion frame review after replacing both directional rows with restrained alternating walking. Original seven nonmovement-state decisions retained. Jump scale difference remains a minor warning.

inspection_scope.method: Initial canonical/contact review and all 57 standard GIF frames were inspected at native 192x208. Seven unchanged rows retain those visual decisions. Repaired right row: all 8 native source PNGs inspected, recorded in running-right-gait-recheck.json. Repaired left row: all 8 native regenerated GIF frames inspected, recorded in running-left-gait-recheck.json. Supplemental nearest-neighbor crops trace the thigh band. No real-time player playback.
inspection_scope.excluded: No other pet directories read. No final/spritesheet/manifest edits. Uncleaned magenta fringe excluded as instructed; this is not final alpha-edge QA.

global_checks.same_chibi_identity: pass: mint/silver bob, purple eyes and consistent proportions/readable face.
global_checks.outfit: pass: chocolate bodice and sleeves, dark shorts, long lace-up boots, single head accessory at screen right and single thigh band retained; no change to skirt or costume.
global_checks.direction: pass: both directional rows face the indicated screen direction.
global_checks.movement_alternation: pass after repaired rows: the banded leg changes between front and rear lead, with gathered poses; rendered as a low-amplitude walk.
global_checks.cropping_and_anatomy: pass: no frame edge contact, missing limb, extra limb, ghost duplicate or detached effect observed.
global_checks.loops: no conspicuous endpoint pop in frame comparison; temporal smoothness not verified by real-time playback.
